import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Calculate average sleep duration and quality of sleep by BMI Category
bmi_sleep_data = data.groupby('BMI Category').agg({
    'Sleep Duration': 'mean',
    'Quality of Sleep': 'mean'
}).reset_index()

# Set style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a bar plot for Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))

# Bar plot for sleep duration
sns.barplot(x='BMI Category', y='Sleep Duration', data=bmi_sleep_data, color='b', label='Sleep Duration', ax=ax)

# Bar plot for quality of sleep
sns.barplot(x='BMI Category', y='Quality of Sleep', data=bmi_sleep_data, color='r', alpha=0.5, label='Quality of Sleep', ax=ax)

# Add labels and title
ax.set_xlabel('BMI Category')
ax.set_ylabel('Average Value')
ax.set_title('Average Sleep Duration and Quality by BMI Category')
ax.legend(title='Metrics')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
